core_principles: No generic 'tech-bro' blue or overused purple gradients.
Organic colors applied to strict, high-contrast structural layouts.
Clear visual hierarchy to manage dense dashboard data (Admin) and task-driven views (Teacher).

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large metrics, hero sections. MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight).

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#141412]

buttons.primary: bg-[#DF5C3D] text-white hover:bg-[#C74B2F] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#214A39] text-white hover:bg-[#1A3A2C] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#141412] text-[#141412] hover:bg-[#141412] hover:text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white border border-[#E5E4E0] rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden

inputs.base: h-12 w-full bg-white border border-[#E5E4E0] rounded-lg px-4 text-[#141412] focus:border-[#DF5C3D] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DF5C3D]/20 outline-none transition-all

sidebar.container: w-64 bg-[#F0EFEA] border-r border-[#E5E4E0] flex flex-col h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 z-40
sidebar.link_default: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-[#575652] hover:bg-[#E5E4E0] hover:text-[#141412] rounded-lg mx-3 transition-colors
sidebar.link_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 bg-white text-[#DF5C3D] shadow-sm rounded-lg mx-3 font-semibold border-l-4 border-[#DF5C3D]

tables.header: bg-[#F7F6F3] text-left text-sm font-semibold text-[#575652] border-b border-[#E5E4E0] py-3 px-4

auth.layout: Split screen (desktop). Left: Hero Image (cover), Right: Form container.
auth.form_section: w-full lg:w-1/2 flex items-center justify-center p-8 sm:p-12
auth.form_card: w-full max-w-md bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#E5E4E0]

dashboard_common.layout: Sidebar on left (w-64), Main content area on right.
dashboard_common.header: h-16 border-b border-[#E5E4E0] bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-between px-8 sticky top-0 z-30

images.description: Abstract minimalist 3D composition of educational items, terracotta and deep pine green. Use on Login/Signup split screen left side.
3D graduation cap and coffee mug. Use for 'Welcome back' banner in Admin/Teacher dashboards.
3D magnifying glass over blank document. Use for zero-data states (no students, no announcements, etc).

testing.mandatory_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='teacher-row-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects. Use Shadcn components heavily, but strip their default borders/radii to match the guidelines above.
Implement the 'Chivo' and 'Work Sans' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Rely strictly on the provided media URLs. Do not use placeholders (like via.placeholder.com).
Admin Dashboard: Ensure dense Data Tables use the outlined table styles with hover effects.
Teacher Dashboard: Needs task-driven UI (attendance UI, grading UI). Use generous padding (p-6).
Parent Dashboard: Read-only views primarily. Use large metric cards and simple charts.
